verdict.rationale: AFK runs processes as directed graphs of steps that can be started, so an inbound webhook trigger is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions a custom webhook URL, inbound HTTP endpoints, or starting a run from an external request payload. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
